name: Hollis Thatch
source_profile: ● Hollis Thatch (NG) is a young Ranger raised among the forest settlements of Thornhollow. Familiar with the customs of the Briarhearth Freeholds and sympathetic to the Velthari, Hollis has become increasingly troubled by the Blackthorns’ role in enforcing disputed logging concessions.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 19 (source excerpt; may be partial)
